project.name: JD to CV desktop and mobile MVP
project.goal: Screenshot to evidence-based resume without a ChatGPT account

constraints.deployment_target: local preview first, Sites Worker after acceptance
constraints.budget: platform funded maximum CNY 5 per Asia/Shanghai day; no real calls until key configured

mvp_must_have.name: Responsive screenshot intake
acceptance: drop/pick PNG JPEG WebP and paste JD text

mvp_must_have.name: Provider and sponsored budget
acceptance: atomic reservation enforces 5 yuan daily ceiling

mvp_must_have.name: Personal profile and resume
acceptance: profile image preview, explicit transcription, append and confirm before local save

mvp_must_have.name: Consent and feedback
acceptance: aggregate events contain no identity or JD

mvp_must_have.name: Desktop distribution
acceptance: Windows executable starts local UI without Python installation

retention_rules: provider receives inputs only after explicit action

approval_evidence: user selected desktop + API key + screenshot drag
user additionally selected mobile web and opt-in anonymous analytics
user chose DeepSeek Flash sponsored pilot capped at CNY 5/day
user additionally requested personal-profile image import
